title: Repeated String Match
description:
Given non-empty strings `a` and `b`, return the minimum number of times `a` must be repeated so that `b` appears as a substring. Return `-1` if no number of repetitions can work.

## Examples

```text
Input: a = "abcd", b = "cdabcdab"
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: a = "a", b = "aa"
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= a.length, b.length <= 10^4`
- `a` and `b` contain only lowercase English letters.
